item.title: Service Ad Without Source Assets

turns.text: Make an 8-second 16:9 ad for ClearDay, a made-up app that turns a messy to-do list into a simple daily plan. I don't have screenshots or a logo—create a simple demo screen yourself. Show the messy list becoming an organized day, then end on ClearDay. Calm blue-and-white look, no sound. Any other wording is up to you.

item.tests: Creates a coherent app ad without supplied assets, visibly demonstrating the service instead of requiring screenshots.

must_haves: The final video is 8 seconds long and landscape 16:9.

style.prompt: Create an 8-second 16:9 motion-graphics advertisement for ClearDay, a fictional app that turns a messy to-do list into a daily plan. Design the demo interface from scratch; no external screenshots or logo needed. Clean flat 2D UI animation, warm white background, dark navy type, sky-blue and mint accents, large readable text, polished minimal product demo. Fixed straight-on camera, no people, no device mockup. 0–2 seconds: scattered overlapping to-do cards in a simple app window, with short labels 'Email', 'Workout', 'Project', 'Groceries', conveying a messy list. 2–5.5 seconds: smoothly animate the SAME cards sliding and snapping into a tidy daily schedule with rows '9 AM Email', '10 AM Project', '12 PM Workout', '5 PM Groceries'; show a clear visual transformation from chaos to an organized daily plan. 5.5–6.5 seconds: hold the organized daily plan briefly. 6.5–8 seconds: clean transition to a minimal end card with only the exact word 'ClearDay.' centered in large crisp navy sans-serif typography on white. Hold the final name clearly until the end. Prioritize the organizing animation and a legible final brand word. No other brands, no watermarks, no extra text.
